children: The Federal Reserve held its policy rate steady in a range between 3.75% and 4% ahead of the November 3 election, but the central bank is poised to hike rates at its December meeting, according to Joseph Brusuelas, principal and chief economist at RSM US.
The FOMC statement was "modestly hawkish," with key points on growth and inflation implying the committee is positioned to raise rates next month, the economist said.

Two dissents from Fed Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack signal that a faction on the committee—which Brusuelas believes represents a majority of the FOMC—is ready to hike rates in December and again at the March 2027 meeting.
"The Fed has fallen behind the curve for inflation," he said, noting that the cost of inaction will require the central bank to consider further rate increases.
Investors have already priced in 25 basis point rate hikes in both December 2026 and March 2027, which aligns with the RSM forecast, according to Brusuelas.

Persistent inflation pressures are driving the hawkish outlook, the economist explained. Assumptions that trade-induced inflation and war-induced energy shocks would unwind "have proved illusory and the price of inaction by the central bank is rising," Brusuelas said.

He added that relentless private non-residential investment around the buildout of artificial intelligence infrastructure appears insensitive to rate hikes, which is part of why the Fed faces "a far heavier lift ahead of it than is commonly acknowledged."

Looking ahead, Brusuelas expects the Fed will hike at every other meeting until there are obvious signs that inflation is abating, financial conditions are tightening, or the economy slows back below its long-term 2% trend.

RSM's research implies the Fed is underestimating what it will take to restore price stability under current conditions, as the energy shock the central bank originally expected to fade is instead intensifying, according to the chief economist.

title: Fed is ‘modestly hawkish,’ will hike interest rates in December – RSM US’s Brusuelas
